basis: Primary Parliament of Australia evidence captured to resolve the current UOMO competition candidate. These snapshots preserve discovery time and do not alter any frozen prediction.

snapshots.source_name: Parliament of Australia — UOMO Bill Details
snapshots.captured_representation: Parliament of Australia bill page for Telecommunications Legislation Amendment (Universal Outdoor Mobile Obligation) Bill 2025 records a Government bill in the Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts portfolio, originating in the House of Representatives and still Before Reps. The page records introduction and second reading moved on 27 November 2025; second reading debates on 2 March, 11 March and 28 May 2026; referral to Federation Chamber and further second reading debate on 11 August 2026. Proposed amendments include a House second-reading amendment by Melissa McIntosh MP and a consideration-in-detail crossbench amendment by Helen Haines MP, and the page lists a Schedule of unresolved question in the Federation Chamber.
snapshots.notes: Primary bill-state evidence establishing a live legislative contest, amendment activity and unresolved chamber state.

snapshots.source_name: Parliament of Australia Hansard — UOMO McIntosh amendment
snapshots.captured_representation: House of Representatives Hansard for 2 March 2026 records Melissa McIntosh MP speaking on the Telecommunications Legislation Amendment (Universal Outdoor Mobile Obligation) Bill 2025 and moving a second-reading amendment that, while not declining the bill a second reading, states that the bill does not provide sufficient certainty of universal outdoor mobile connectivity within the requisite timeframe and places a vague and uncertain obligation on carriers.
snapshots.notes: Primary parliamentary evidence of a sourced altering position. It is not converted into an unsupported claim that McIntosh seeks outright defeat of the bill.

snapshots.source_name: Parliament of Australia — Daily Program 27 November 2025
snapshots.captured_representation: Parliament of Australia Daily Program for 27 November 2025 lists Telecommunications Legislation Amendment (Universal Outdoor Mobile Obligation) Bill 2025 as government business and states that Anika Wells MP, Minister for Communications, was to present the bill, with first reading and second reading to be moved.
snapshots.notes: Primary parliamentary evidence identifying the government player presenting and seeking passage of the bill.
